newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CBD NZ buys Auckland property for NZ$12.5 million.
newsitem.headline: CBD NZ buys Auckland property for NZ$12.5 million.

text.p: CBD New Zealand Ltd, a newly established vehicle for specialist commercial property investment, said on Thursday it had bought a 19-floor Auckland building for NZ$12.5 million.
The building is CBD's first property purchase since the company was formed in late 1996. It is capitalised initially by Westpac Investment Management NZ Ltd.
CBD plans to target investment in quality commercial properties in Auckland, Wellington and Christchurch, focusing initially on $12-25 million properties in Auckland's central business district.
Company spokesman Chris Morrison said the outlook for the commercial property sector was very positive.

He noted vacancy rates in the Auckland and Wellington central business districts had fallen consistently over the last year, with an undersupply of good quality office space forecast for later in 1997 in parts of Auckland.
"We believe this will lead to upward pressure on rentals and ultimately property values," Morrison said.

CBD will be managed by CBD NZ Management Ltd, a company jointly owned by Morrison & Co and Willis Bond & Co. The latter also jointly own the Management Company, which manages listed company Property for Industry Ltd.
